title: Hi-C/3C-Seq/Capture-C
scope: Illumina explanatory family schematic: a descriptive chromatin overview followed by one unbranched route labelled Crosslink proteins and DNA → Sample fragmentation → Ligation → PCR amplify ligated junctions → a right-edge DNA endpoint whose caption is clipped. Sequencing is established by the catalogue and primary papers. The graph retains this route and explicitly represents its omitted DNA-recovery/library-template interface using qualified primary evidence. It is not a complete protocol or a claim that the named family members share identical enrichment or sequencing carriers. Hi-C refers here to the cited 2009 implementation; 3C-Seq is mapped to the cited Duan 2012 genome-wide derivative; Capture-C is qualified at the supplied abstract/catalogue evidence level. NG Capture-C is only a catalogue mention, with no separately extracted architecture. No historical-development edge or invention date is inferred.

states.label: Chromatin DNA with associated proteins
features: The overview caption names Chromatin conformation capture (3-C, Hi-C and Capture-C). Grey nucleosome-like bodies and a blue protein icon illustrate DNA-associated proteins; their specific identities are not given.
The biological target is spatial association between genomic DNA regions. The proteins participate in preserving proximity; the sequenced carrier is DNA.

states.label: Ligation-derived DNA library templates, qualified by implementation
features: A protein-free DNA template boundary is implicit between the protein-associated Ligation panel and linear PCR panel. Crosslink reversal and DNA recovery after proximity ligation are established by the primary 3C protocol, rather than depicted as separate operations.
Hi-C: purified, sheared DNA fragments containing biotinylated ligation junctions are selected with streptavidin beads.

states.label: DNA sequence evidence for associated genomic fragments
features: DNA sequence is the readout, rather than sequence of the blue protein. Paired-end sequencing in the Hi-C and Duan papers identifies the genomic pieces represented by a ligation-derived library molecule.
The collection of represented fragment pairs supports chromatin-contact frequencies. The original Hi-C paper interprets these as an ensemble average across the sampled cells.

A ligation read is evidence of an assay-captured association, not proof of a functional regulatory interaction. Crosslinked random collisions, self-ligation, adjacent ligation and random intermolecular ligation can contribute background.

Base-level sequence of a library molecule does not itself establish base-pair spatial resolution of chromatin contacts. The Hi-C paper reports a contact matrix over genomic regions, while the Capture-C abstract supports selected cis interactions without specifying the library chemistry.

operations.mechanism: Common interface: reverse crosslinks and recover DNA. Hi-C: purify/shear DNA and select biotinylated junction fragments with streptavidin. method_scopes.rationale: Resolved for the 2009 Lieberman-Aiden implementation at schematic granularity. The first three drawn operations correspond to formaldehyde crosslinking, restriction digestion and proximity ligation. Its distinguishing interface is 5′-overhang fill-in with a biotinylated residue before ligation, then DNA purification/shearing and streptavidin enrichment of biotin-containing junction fragments before paired-end sequencing. These omitted stages are qualified within o_fragment and o_library_interface; the unlabelled orange rectangle is not assigned as biotin. The PCR stage is retained from the diagram/catalogue as amplification of a library representation, without inferring locus-specific primer design from the coloured arrows. This is not an assertion about all later Hi-C or in situ implementations.

method_scopes.rationale: The catalogue heading says 3C-Seq, its reference label says 3-C, and the inspected Duan 2012 paper describes a particular genome-wide 3C/4C derivative. These labels are linked by the catalogue citation, not treated as proof that ordinary locus-specific 3C is the same method. The shared operations apply at a compressed level. Between initial 3C ligation and final PCR/sequencing, this implementation digests with RE2, circularizes, reopens RE1 sites, attaches EcoP15I-site adapters, marks anchoring sites with biotin through DNA circularization, generates paired-end tags with EcoP15I, and selects them with streptavidin. The physical sequencing carrier is therefore a tag construct derived from interacting DNA fragments. Its downstream construction is distinct from Hi-C junction-fragment enrichment and is kept inside the explicitly qualified library interface, not drawn as an extra Illumina branch.

evidence.quote: Briefly, the method starts with construction of a 3C library, followed by digestion of the library with a second restriction enzyme (RE2). evidence.locator: Introduction [b00007], version-specific readout carrier

method_scopes.rationale: The overview caption and catalogue include Capture-C within the family-level route, but the drawing shows no separate capture branch, beads, capture probe or capture-specific operation. The supplied Hughes 2014 abstract supports high-throughput measurement of selected cis interactions, and the catalogue claims an additional magnetic-bead pull-down of biotinylated fragments. Abstract-only primary evidence does not establish which molecule carries biotin, probe hybridization chemistry, or the capture position relative to library construction/PCR. Accordingly the graph preserves the advertised family depiction without assigning a complete protocol-specific operation sequence to Capture-C. The catalogue-only NG Capture-C refinement is mentioned but no separate implementation is extracted.

corrections.primary_statement: The Duan protocol explicitly places restriction digestion of crosslinked chromatin before proximity ligation and crosslink reversal/DNA recovery after ligation. evidence.quote: We constructed a genome-wide contact matrix M by dividing the genome into 1 Mb regions (‘loci’) and defining the matrix entry mij to be the number of ligation products between locus i and locus j (SOM).
